attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 dupcheshwar-shelter tadi-school
load car1 child 1
drive car1 tadi-school benighat-market
load car1 elderly 3
drive car1 benighat-market dupcheshwar-shelter
unload car1 child 1
unload car1 elderly 3
drive car1 dupcheshwar-shelter benighat-market
drive car1 benighat-market myagang-care-home
drive car1 myagang-care-home tarkeshwar-care-home
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 tarkeshwar-care-home myagang-care-home
drive car1 myagang-care-home benighat-market
drive car1 benighat-market dupcheshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car2 panchakanya-hospital trishuli-market
load car2 elderly 4
drive car2 trishuli-market panchakanya-hospital
unload car2 elderly 4
defer trishuli-market adult 4
defer uttargaya-care-home adult 4
</plan>
COST: 401

Notes on the plan:
- Driving totals 241 minutes (car1: 27 + 84, car2: 130). Deferrals total 160 (eight adults at 20 each).
- Tadi school is used only as a pickup point, never as a drop-off, since it is not a designated evacuation point.
- The plan avoids the two flood-damaged roads (Benighat–Panchakanya and Benighat–Syaphru). Those are the roads where a truck was swept off this morning.
- Rescuing the Trishuli adults or the Uttargaya adults would cost more driving than the 20-minute penalty per adult, so they are deferred. Deferring them is the cheaper option.
